calculation.description: For each asset, subtract its trailing 15-session log return from the equal-weight mean trailing 15-session log return of the other asset groups (equities, commodities, crypto, yields), then percentile-rank cross-sectionally. Higher values indicate relative underperformance and expected reversal.

validation.regime_notes: IC/ICIR by regime: 2020-2024 -0.003115/-0.008398; 2025-2027 0.037694/0.110895; 2028-2029 0.016088/0.053309; 2030-2032-10-13 0.069398/0.235403. Early regime was weak/negative; later regimes were positive. Interpret uncertainty conservatively for 15 assets.
